Carted off during Cincinnati's first padded/11-on-11 training camp practice. Follow-up testing showed no ligament damage; coach Zac Taylor said the 2025 first-round pick avoided a major injury and is considered week-to-week.

Originally hurt in an October 2024 collision with Derrick Henry. Placed on reserve/PUP for a second straight season; not expected to play in 2026.

Progressed to full 11-on-11 team work Monday, Aug. 3 (his first full team snaps of camp), was pulled back to a limited practice Tuesday, Aug. 4 as a precaution, then returned to 11-on-11 again Wednesday, Aug. 5 in the team's second padded practice. Tua says he expects to be full-go soon and could 'likely' play if it were a game week; still in a QB competition with Michael Penix Jr.

Hurt during minicamp; opened camp on PUP. GM Omar Khan estimated he'd be out 'a couple of weeks' - no surgery required. Began rehab work (stretching, light jogging) Aug. 1-2, an early sign of progress.
Suffered in Week 15 last season vs. Denver. Placed on PUP to open camp; targeting a return around Week 6.
Sat out Thursday's practice with a groin issue. Coach Matt LaFleur and Jacobs both described it as minor (a 'tweak'); not expected to cost him significant time.
Left practice July 24 with a hamstring strain that an MRI confirmed as mild. Returned to practice July 29; Week 1 vs. Chicago (Sept. 8) remains the target for full speed.

Strained lifting weights ahead of camp; placed on PUP list on the first day of training camp. Traded to Philadelphia from Minnesota in April 2026 on a 4-year, $100M deal; injury is not expected to be long-term.

Missed practice Monday and Tuesday with a hamstring injury suffered at Eagles training camp; the team says it's not serious and there's no long-term concern, but is being handled cautiously as a soft-tissue issue with no firm return timetable.

Recovering from a torn ACL/meniscus suffered in Week 4 last season vs. the Chargers, plus a follow-up spring surgery to clear scar tissue. Took part in the individual portion of a full-team practice July 29-30 for the first time since the injury and 'looked good,' but coach John Harbaugh and GM Joe Schoen won't yet commit to a Week 1 (vs. Dallas) timeline, saying his workload will be managed day-to-day.

Suffered the injury Dec. 14, 2025 vs. the Chargers, ending his 2025 season; had knee debridement surgery in May. Fully cleared off the PUP list for camp and has been a full practice participant, including 11-on-11 team drills, since late July.

Left Wednesday's joint practice vs. Atlanta clutching his groin and did not return; HC Shane Steichen confirmed the injury. Per NFL insider Jordan Schultz, the Colts avoided a critical injury — Warren is expected to be out roughly a week, not weeks — though he'll be shut down for the rest of camp/preseason as a precaution. Second-year first-round pick coming off a strong rookie season (76 catches, 817 yards, 5 total TDs) and expected to be a lead target for Daniel Jones; trending toward being ready for the regular season.
